h_distributed_directly: NO - energy not distributed as H; only ET (no LE either)

temporal_resolution_distributed: monthly on ICOS portal (easy access); hourly exists in a separate Zarr store on DKRZ, access path not confirmed

citation_method: Nelson et al. (2024) is both product and method paper for X-BASE

temporal_resolution_distributed: monthly via FTP; finer resolution (daily/8-daily) by request to M. Jung only

access_portal: MPI-BGC data-exchange portal (registration-gated FTP via fluxcom.org CF-Download page); exact FileID not found
point_extraction_size_estimate: combined carbon monthly+member FTP archive ~179+ GB; native/finer-than-monthly >4 TB by request; no point-extraction API, full-grid monthly netCDFs only; rough point-extraction burden order several GB

variables_distributed: GPP, TER, NEE (+ _MAD, _n member count); reuses Tramontana (2016) trained ML models, not independently retrained
reco_distributed_directly: YES - TER is its own distributed variable
period: forcing-dependent: CRU JRA v1.1 1950-2017; GSWP3 1950-2010; WFDEI 1979-2013; ERA5 1979-2018; CERES-GPCP 2001-2013 (plus pooled METEO-ALL)
temporal_resolution_distributed: monthly distributed via FTP; finer resolution by request
daytime_partition_member: YES - same FP-NT/FP-DT/FP-ALL/FP-NONE labeling as RS carbon (same Table S2 convention), applies to GPP and TER

citation_method: Jung et al. (2020) - explicitly reuses Tramontana (2016) trained models

h_distributed_directly: YES - H is its own distributed variable (not derived from ET)
period: 2001-2015 (headline global stats computed over 2001-2013; distributed monthly files cover 2001-2015)
spatial_resolution: 0.0833 deg native (~9.2 km); 0.5 deg version also distributed
temporal_resolution_distributed: 8-daily documented as native (some source inconsistency with Jung 2019 text); monthly is what's distributed via FTP; finer by request to M. Jung
daytime_partition_member: NOT APPLICABLE - day/night partitioning is a carbon-flux-specific concept; ensemble axes here are ML method (9: RF/ANN/MARS/GMDH/KRR/SVM-SVR/3x MTE variants) x energy-balance-closure correction (Bowen-ratio/residual/none, LE and H only)
access_portal: MPI-BGC data-exchange portal, FileID 257 confirmed via arXiv:1812.04951
point_extraction_size_estimate: full monthly FTP directory ~214 GB total; native/finer products >4 TB by request; no point-extraction API (EF-ReleaseInfo page is HTTP 404); realistic point-extraction burden multiple GB of whole-grid downloads even though final series is KB-scale
citation_method: Tramontana et al. (2016) is the underlying ML-method paper; Jung et al. (2019) is the energy ensemble/product paper
